client_scope.jurisdiction: CN/Guangdong/Shenzhen; HK bank receipt nexus is not tax residency
client_scope.summary: SYNTHETIC high-income, high market-correlated cashflow client; not a real person

fact_basis.explanation: All inputs hypothetical; tax residence, income characterization and bank/broker ownership not verified.

assets.description: Illustrative HK bank, actual current deposit unknown; not a real bank record
Brokerage monthly P&L range does not establish net equity or withdrawable cash
Not personally owned; illustrative only; prohibited in pools

liabilities.kind: Vehicle loan outstanding balance unknown; monthly debt service assumed USD 1500

balance_sheet.net_worth_notes: NAV, bank balance, margin balances, loan principal, taxes and other obligations unknown; do not claim a net worth.

cash_policy.surplus_statement: Illustrative $60k bank credit less $4.5k known monthly spending (or $5.5k if $1k prior leisure persists) BEFORE unresolved tax/operating/loan principal distinction; not investable cash.

goals.purpose: Financial independence from active trading; verify lifestyle, dependants, target horizon
goals.blocker: Age, desired passive spending, existing assets and taxes unknown

pools.objective: Cover essential expenses and debt payments through a joint-income shock
pools.funding_rule: Propose reserve based on verified spend and true cash once current bank equity known; no cash moved automatically

pools.objective: Avoid committing money potentially owed for taxes
pools.funding_rule: No arbitrary tax rate; set conditional hold pending specialist computation based on current law

pools.objective: Protect trading business continuity within risk limits
pools.funding_rule: Cash allocation conditional on verified operation costs and strategy constraints

pools.objective: Fund non-trading retirement spending with capital whose long horizon permits risk
pools.funding_rule: Evaluate only after personal ownership, law and goals verified

policies.objective: Establish one owned-wealth ledger and no fake income
policies.then: Reconcile PF cash receipts, brokerage net equity and internal transfers with dated evidence
policies.block_if: Ownership or source ambiguity means no claims of verified deposits
policies.metric: Bank receipts reconciled; NAV not added to P&L
policies.review_trigger: At material payout, broker drawdown or year end

policies.objective: Keep unresolved taxes out of presumed free investment money
policies.when: Before deciding a transfer from traded income into long-term assets
policies.then: Obtain a qualified CN/HK cross-border tax opinion, preserve tax/operating holds as provisional
policies.block_if: Unknown resident status or income classification; no exact liability or unconditional investment allocation
policies.metric: Tax status/cash reserve verified in writing by appropriate professional
policies.review_trigger: Tax residency changes, tax year changes, new broker/legal entity

policies.objective: Finance household essential cash and business risk separately
policies.when: Once current owned cash and expenses verified
policies.then: Present reserve-first vs gradual long-horizon funding options for user approval
policies.block_if: No verified owned cash, deficit or tax hold insufficient
policies.metric: Protected liquid months and amount truly transferred to long-term capital
policies.review_trigger: Loss of trading income or joint income/portfolio stress

options.description: Leave current trading/broker funds managed as before while verifying account balances and taxes
prerequisites: No new external transfers until ownership, liquidity and tax obligations are understood
options.tradeoffs: May leave correlated income and assets; preserves trading flexibility and liquidity
options.why_it_loses: Does not establish independent long-term capital or explicit household protection

options.description: Create policy earmarks for liquidity and uncertain tax, then propose recurring extraction of verified post-obligation surplus into distinct long-horizon capital
prerequisites: User risk and FI goal confirmation
options.tradeoffs: May reduce capital usable in active trading; more recordkeeping, no guaranteed investment gain
options.why_it_loses: Blocked as an unconditional percentage or transfer until outstanding liabilities, tax and NAV are known

stress_tests.shock: Income receipts zero for six months AND personally owned brokerage equity declines materially
stress_tests.finding: Without starting cash/NAV unknown, cannot claim survival; compute six-month bills under $4.5k/$5.5k monthly spending scenarios once verified

actions.description: Reconcile monthly external receipts and personally owned brokerage net equity, car loan balance, essential vs discretionary spending
actions.prerequisite: Private user-provided aggregate records; optional L1 permission for reads
actions.proof_metric: Dated cash/broker/liability ledger with income source and missing lines

actions.description: Confirm cross-border tax status and classify material income, then propose realistic cash tax reserve
actions.prerequisite: Engage qualified practitioner with relevant jurisdictions and current-year law
actions.proof_metric: Written issue list with professional findings and exceptions; no invented rates

actions.description: Review actual capital moved from active trading to genuinely separate household long-term capital after valid obligations
actions.prerequisite: Approved policy and reconciled capital flows, no autonomous account action
actions.proof_metric: Owned net new retained assets by currency; tax/compliance status; no transfer double count

reviews.trigger: On user-requested review or actually authorized scheduler, when statements are available
metrics: Owned net cash newly retained, by USD currency

reviews.trigger: End of tax year or major change in law/household
metrics: Verified owned net worth by currency

reviews.trigger: Concurrent loss of trading income and drop in brokerage equity

blockers.question: Which jurisdiction(s) regard the person as tax resident and how is each income stream characterized?
blockers.blocks: Exact tax liability and unconditional after-tax investment funding

blockers.question: What is personal brokerage net equity and how much profit was bank withdrawn versus retained?
blockers.blocks: Exact net worth, risk exposure and liquidity allocations

blockers.question: What is the spending level and date for independence?
blockers.blocks: Precise FI amount and policy allocation

evidence.claim: Illustrative 60k PF deposit and 100k–300k claimed trading P&L, not a verified balance or tax fact
evidence.source: Synthetic scenario only; no real person or bank account

permissions.note: No actions or files were written to any real financial account, no consent assumed.
